items.question: When a log row cannot be parsed, how should the loader account for it?

options.label: (a)
options.text: add a separate UnparsedRows counter and show it on the report

options.label: (b)
options.text: drop the row silently; the existing total is enough

items.rationale: The unparsed count has been zero on every file we have measured, so (a) adds a report field for a number that is always zero. (b) is adequate for now; we can defer the counter until a parse failure actually happens.

items.question: A span holds some rows with a sequence number and some legacy rows without one. How is completeness judged?

options.label: (a)
options.text: walk the sequence across every row, legacy rows included

options.label: (b)
options.text: fall back wholly to the time tolerance for a mixed span

items.rationale: A sequence gap that straddles a legacy row cannot tell a dropped row from a row that never carried a sequence, so the number (a) computes has no meaning. (b) is the only reading that stays interpretable.
